title: scrophularia oblongifolia subsp. neesii
intro: Scrophularia oblongifolia subsp. neesii, commonly known as a species of figwort, is a plant that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia oblongifolia subsp. neesii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, as well as a potential antiviral and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
